<reason>PRO won by turning CON's own account-ban concession into a limiting principle: liability for proven contributing failure, not every crash. That answered the vagueness/hindsight pressure with an exact knowable failure, distinguished rental-car vicarious liability, and exposed why a city fine does not compensate the victim. CON never justified the permit-only vs tort barrier or rider-deterrence dilution.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A's R2 A1-A2 plus A4.5: giving the exact failure of ignoring a required suspension to answer B's Q1, then charging inconsistency that clear triggers cannot be knowable for permits but unknowable for damages.</best_rebuttal>
